overview: Acrylia Frontier marks the transition from Scarlet Desert’s sands to the fortified stone of Acrylia Caverns.
details: Acrillian scouts maintain outposts to monitor sun revenant incursions and crystal-sun anomalies spilling from the desert.
hooks: A sun revenant warband approaches the frontier.
Acrillian scouts report crystal barricades destabilizing.
A new cavern breach opens toward the desert.
A caravan seeks escort through the frontier.
